```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(lme4)
library(lmerTest)
library(tidyverse)
library(emmeans)
library(here)
```

```{r}
tp_growth <- read_csv(here("raw data", "plants_field", "TP_RGR_JB_SMR26.csv"))
tp_growth <- tp_growth |>
  mutate(
    b1_full_cm_unbroken = ifelse(b1_broken == "y", NA, b1_full_cm),
    b2_full_cm_unbroken = ifelse(b2_broken == "y", NA, b2_full_cm),
    b3_full_cm_unbroken = ifelse(b3_broken == "y", NA, b3_full_cm),
    b4_full_cm_unbroken = ifelse(b4_broken == "y", NA, b4_full_cm),
    b5_full_cm_unbroken = ifelse(b5_broken == "y", NA, b5_full_cm),
    b6_full_cm_unbroken = ifelse(b6_broken == "y", NA, b6_full_cm),
    b7_full_cm_unbroken = ifelse(b7_broken == "y", NA, b7_full_cm),
    n_unbroken_leaves = rowSums(!is.na(across(matches("^b[1-7]_full_cm_unbroken$")))),
    sum_new_growth    = rowSums(across(matches("^b[1-7]_new_cm$")), na.rm = TRUE),
    sum_full          = rowSums(across(matches("^b[1-7]_full_cm$")), na.rm = TRUE),
    sum_full_unbroken = rowSums(across(matches("^b[1-7]_full_cm_unbroken$")), na.rm = TRUE),
    body_size = log(sum_full_unbroken*leaf_width_cm),
    RGR2 = ifelse(
      n_unbroken_leaves >= 4,
      (sum_new_growth / sum_full_unbroken / interval) * 100,
      NA),
    RGR  = sum_new_growth / sheath_length_cm / interval)
tp_growth
```
```{r}
RGR_model <- lm(RGR ~ source * outplant, data = tp_growth)
anova(RGR_model)
plot(RGR_model)
shapiro.test(resid(RGR_model))
```


```{r}
tp_growth <- tp_growth |> 
  mutate(outplant = factor(outplant, levels = c("VC11_00", "VC11_01", "hist")))

RGR_summary_df <- tp_growth |> 
  group_by(source, outplant)  |> 
  summarise(
    mean_RGR = mean(RGR, na.rm = TRUE),
    se_RGR = sd(RGR, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

RGR_summary_df <- RGR_summary_df |>
  mutate(
    source = recode(source,
                    "VC11_00"   = "Coastal",
                    "VC11_01"   = "Estuarine"),
    outplant = recode(outplant,
                    "VC11_00"   = "Coastal",
                    "VC11_01"   = "Estuarine",
                    "hist" = "Restoration site"))
```
```{r}
RGRplot <- ggplot(RGR_summary_df, aes(x = outplant, y = mean_RGR, color = source, group = source)) +
  geom_line(position = position_dodge(width = 0.1), linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point(position = position_dodge(width = 0.1), size = 3) +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(ymin = mean_RGR - se_RGR, ymax = mean_RGR + se_RGR),
    width = 0.1,
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.1)
  ) +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = expression("Relative Growth (cm d"^-1*")"),
    color = "Source"
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      "Coastal" = "#009999",
      "Estuarine" = "#ff3300"))+
  theme_classic()+
  annotate("text", x = -Inf, y = Inf, hjust = 0, vjust = 1.3, 
           label ="   Source, p < 0.01\n   Outplant, p < 0.001\n   Source:Outplant, p = 0.93",
           size = 3, lineheight = 0.9)
RGRplot
```
```{r Site map}
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
library(rnaturalearth)
library(rnaturalearthdata)
library(ggspatial)
library(ggrepel)
library(patchwork)

TP_sites <- read_csv(here("raw data", "plants_field", "site_coords.csv")) |> 
  filter(!is.na(Latitude), !is.na(Longitude))

TP_sites <- st_as_sf(TP_sites, coords = c("Longitude", "Latitude"),
                     crs = 4326, remove = FALSE)

bb_sites <- st_bbox(TP_sites)
pad_x <- 0.012; pad_y <- 0.008
xlim_map <- unname(c(bb_sites["xmin"] - pad_x, bb_sites["xmax"] + pad_x))
ylim_map <- unname(c(bb_sites["ymin"] - pad_y, bb_sites["ymax"] + pad_y))

dir.create(here("raw data", "spatial"), showWarnings = FALSE)
land_zip <- here("raw data", "spatial", "land-polygons-complete-4326.zip")
land_shp <- here("raw data", "spatial", "land-polygons-complete-4326", "land_polygons.shp")

if (!file.exists(land_shp)) {
  options(timeout = 3600)
  download.file("https://osmdata.openstreetmap.de/download/land-polygons-complete-4326.zip",
                land_zip, mode = "wb")
  unzip(land_zip, exdir = here("raw data", "spatial"))
}

read_box <- st_as_sfc(st_bbox(c(xmin = xlim_map[1] - 0.1, xmax = xlim_map[2] + 0.1,
                                ymin = ylim_map[1] - 0.1, ymax = ylim_map[2] + 0.1),
                              crs = st_crs(4326)))
land_hr <- st_read(land_shp, wkt_filter = st_as_text(read_box), quiet = TRUE) |>
  st_make_valid()

study_box <- st_as_sfc(bb_sites)

land_overview <- ne_countries(scale = "medium", continent = "North America",
                              returnclass = "sf")

land_fix <- st_read(here("raw data", "spatial", "map_fix.kml")) |>
  st_transform(4326) |>
  st_make_valid()

sf_use_s2(FALSE)

land_all <- c(st_geometry(land_hr), st_geometry(land_fix)) |>
  st_make_valid() |>
  st_union() |>
  st_sf()

sf_use_s2(TRUE)

TP_sites <- TP_sites |>
  mutate(Site = recode(Site,
    "VC11_hist" = "Restoration site",
    "VC11_00"   = "Coastal",
    "VC11_01"   = "Estuarine"
  ))

site_cols <- c(
  "Coastal"     = "#009999",
  "Estuarine"   = "#ff3300",
  "Restoration" = "black"
)
```

```{r}
TP_inset_map <- ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = land_overview, fill = "white", color = "gray50", linewidth = 0.2) +
  # study area is tiny at this scale, so mark it with a visible hollow square
  geom_sf(data = st_centroid(study_box), shape = 0, size = 3, stroke = 0.9, color = "red") +
  coord_sf(xlim = c(-88, -74), ylim = c(49, 58), expand = FALSE) +
  theme_void() +
  theme(panel.background = element_rect(fill = "lightblue", color = NA),
        panel.border     = element_rect(fill = NA, color = "black", linewidth = 0.8))

TP_site_map <- ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = land_hr, fill = "white", color = NA, linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_sf(data = land_fix, fill = "white", color = NA, linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_sf(data = TP_sites, aes(color = Site), size = 3) +
  scale_color_manual(values = site_cols) +
  geom_text_repel(data = st_drop_geometry(TP_sites),
                  aes(x = Longitude, y = Latitude, label = Site),
                  size = 3, box.padding = 0.4, min.segment.length = 0,
                  segment.size = 0.25, seed = 1) +
  coord_sf(xlim = xlim_map, ylim = ylim_map, expand = FALSE) +
  scale_x_continuous(n.breaks = 3) +
  scale_y_continuous(n.breaks = 4) +
  annotation_scale(location = "bl", width_hint = 0.25, text_cex = 0.6,
                   bar_cols = c("black", "white"), line_width = 0.5) +
  annotation_north_arrow(location = "br", which_north = "true",
                         style = north_arrow_minimal(text_size = 12),
                         height = unit(1.2, "cm"), width = unit(1.2, "cm"),
                         pad_x = unit(0.3, "cm"), pad_y = unit(0.4, "cm")) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(panel.background = element_rect(fill = "lightblue"),
        panel.grid = element_blank(),
        axis.title = element_blank(),
        legend.position = "none")

TP_final_map <- TP_site_map +
  inset_element(TP_inset_map, left = 0.68, bottom = 0.68, right = 0.98, top = 0.98)
TP_final_map
```
